metadata.title: Musk vs. Wall Street: Can SpaceX Really Reach $3.5 Trillion in Sales?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Elon Musk Thinks SpaceX Can Hit $3.5 Trillion in Revenue. Wall Street Isn’t Buying It.
Elon Musk is never one to shy away from big goals. He made another bold prediction on Thursday.
